2607.26661.title: AgenticCANN: Automated Ascend C Operator Generation via Knowledge-Augmented Agentic Evolution
2607.26661.paper_summary: Ascend C operator optimization is critical for NPU (Neural Processing Unit) inference performance but requires deep hardware expertise.While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automated CUDA kernel generation, the fundamentally different programming model of Ascend C introduces unique challenges that remain unexplored. In this paper, we propose AgenticCANN, a knowledge-augmented agentic evolution framework specifically tailored for automated Ascend C operator synthesis in low-corpus NPU environments.To overcome the severe platform knowledge deficit on unfamiliar hardware, AgenticCANN incorporates a knowledge-orchestrated generation system that delivers structured, multi-level domain insights across the development lifecycle to resolve the upstream feasibility bottleneck.Building on this foundation, it features a stage-adaptive agentic evolution strategy that dynamically aligns LLM interaction modes with specific generation and evolution phases, balancing high-exploration candidate discovery with high-convergence performance tuning.Extensive experiments on Huawei Ascend 910B across six operators spanning five pattern categories demonstrate that our method achieves 90 to 100 percent feasibility on elementwise and normalization operators, 56% on fusion operators, and up to 6.65$\times$ speedup on 1B Pangu model inference kernels. Further analysis reveals that knowledge injection monotonically improves feasibility from 57% to 86% on elementwise operators, demonstrating its general rather than operator-specific benefit.
2607.26661.paper_summary_zh: Ascend C 操作符優化對於 NPU（神經處理單元）推理性能至關重要，但需要深厚的硬體專業知識。<lb/>雖然大型語言模型（LLMs）在自動化 CUDA 核心生成方面顯示出潛力，但 Ascend C 的根本不同的編程模型引入了尚未探索的獨特挑戰。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了 AgenticCANN，一個知識增強的代理進化框架，專門為低語料 NPU 環境中的自動化 Ascend C 操作符合成量身定制。<lb/>為了克服對不熟悉硬體的嚴重平台知識不足，AgenticCANN 結合了一個知識協調生成系統，提供結構化的多層次領域見解，涵蓋開發生命周期，以解決上游可行性瓶頸。<lb/>在此基礎上，它具有一種階段自適應的代理進化策略，動態調整 LLM 互動模式與特定生成和進化階段的對應，平衡高探索候選發現與高收斂性能調整。<lb/>在華為 Ascend 910B 上對六個操作符進行的廣泛實驗，涵蓋五個模式類別，顯示我們的方法在逐元素和歸一化操作符上達到 90% 至 100% 的可行性，在融合操作符上達到 56%，並在 1B Pangu 模型推理核心上實現高達 6.65$\times$ 的加速。<lb/>進一步分析顯示，知識注入單調地將逐元素操作符的可行性從 57% 提高到 86%，證明其具有一般性而非操作特定的好處。
